svg.title: ObservedState account and permission fence
svg.desc: Two AWS accounts and four identities: the Cloud Study account is never used; in stacknimbus the rook admin user sets up a fenced observedstate user whose policy and permissions boundary only reach observedstate-star resources.
svg.text: Which account, which profile, and what each identity can reach
Runs at the top of every AWS block.
Nothing from this runbook is built here.
The audit found and removed 1 stray bucket and
1 OIDC provider created by mistake on Oct 8.
S3 all actions, only on observedstate-* buckets
CloudFront all actions ACM all actions in us-east-1
Route 53 read and change records in this one zone
IAM create or manage roles named observedstate-*
IAM CreateRole only with the boundary attached
IAM manage the GitHub OIDC provider only
iam:DeleteRolePermissionsBoundary: the boundary cannot be removed
EC2, VPC, RDS and every other service
Effective rights = deploy policy AND observedstate-boundary
S3 list/put/delete on the site bucket, CloudFront invalidation
S3 List, Get, Put, Delete on observedstate-*
A role can never exceed this, whatever it is given
